title: ignite/config.json
description: Ignite's configuration on one machine, at .rbtv/config/ignite/config.json. Read by Ignite's programs; never shared with another machine.

slack.description: The Slack workspace Ignite connects to.

botUserId.description: The Slack user id of Ignite's bot.

ownerUserId.description: The Slack user id of the one person the agents answer.

appTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the app-level token that opens the connection.

botTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the bot token that posts replies.

ownerTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the owner's user token.

stoolsWorkspace.description: The name the Slack command-line tool uses for this workspace.

tools.description: The commands Ignite runs, as their names on PATH.

cast.description: The command that runs each agent turn.

audio.description: The command that transcribes and speaks audio.

dmAgent.description: The agent that receives the owner's direct messages. Absent when no agent does.

routes.description: Which agent each Slack channel connects to: channel id to agent name. One channel connects to one agent.
